title: OCX theme glossary
description: The terms the docs link to a glossary page and explain in a popover. `validate` from @ocx-sh/theme/glossary also checks what a schema cannot: unique ids and forms, and the 25-word limit on a definition.

id.description: The anchor of the term's entry on the glossary page.

term.description: The canonical name: the entry heading and the popover title.

variants.description: Every form of the term that links to it, inflections included (no stemming). A form with an uppercase letter matches exactly, a lowercase one in any case.

learnMore.description: A docs route ending in a slash with an optional fragment, or an http(s) URL.

avoid.description: Synonyms the docs must not use for this term; a consumer's lint reports them.

except.description: Phrases containing a variant that are not the term (`package manager` for `package`): they match first and link nothing.

excludePages.description: Docs route prefixes (`integration/github-actions/`) on whose pages this term is never linked, because the bare word means something else there. Other terms, longer forms containing the word included, still link.
